sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Alsager Town on Saturday looking to extend their impressive run. Sandbach have won their last four games and sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 matches, while Alsager Town are struggling at the foot of the division with just 4 points from 10 games and five consecutive defeats in their recent form.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a home fixture against Dawley Town as they chase down Sandbach United's lead; Stafford's recent draw suggests they remain competitive contenders. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the standings, welcome Eccleshall in a clash between two top-six sides, with Bridgnorth looking to bounce back from their sole recent loss. Wolverhampton Casuals host Wednesfield Community in a battle of mid-table teams both carrying mixed recent form. Bilston Town (5th) travel to face Foley Meir (13th) in a fixture between contrasting league positions. Barnton host Shawbury United, where the visitors are enduring a severe slump with five consecutive defeats; Barnton themselves have shown recent promise with a win. New Mills, sitting 8th, visit Market Drayton Town (10th) in a meeting of mid-table sides. Crewe face Allscott Heath, with both teams struggling in the lower half; Crewe's recent form includes two consecutive losses. Cheadle Heath Nomads (17th, drawing their last two) travel to Telford Town (18th), the joint-lowest scorers in the division with a goal difference of -10. Brereton Social host Widnes Town in what appears a bottom-half encounter, with Widnes in particularly dire straits at the foot of the table with just 2 points and five defeats in their last six.
